section1.heading: About Us
section1.card1: We are committed to creating a sustainable, transparent, and mutually beneficial business ecosystem, connecting retailers, logistics partners, and resellers across Indonesia.
section1.card2: Bulky.id is Indonesia's first online retail liquidation company, helping businesses efficiently manage excess stock, returned goods, and failed delivery products.
section1.card3: We deliver innovative stock management solutions, ensuring every product retains its value while opening new profit opportunities for business owners.

section3.heading: We Are Here to Support Entrepreneurs, Resellers, and SMEs
section3.p1: Through Bulky.id, business owners can access quality wholesale stock at more affordable prices, while also having the opportunity to start a business without large capital.
section3.p2: We also help partners increase profits through a transparent, efficient, and trusted distribution system.

section4.heading: Bulky.id Ecosystem
section4.p1: We collaborate with major retailers, distributors, and logistics partners across Indonesia. From collection and sorting to distribution, every step of the process runs on a fast and reliable digital system.
section4.p2: Turning excess stock into new, sustainable business opportunities.

section5.heading: Bulky News
section5.featuredTitle: Thousands of Business Owners Use Bulky.id to Get Affordable Stock

news.title: Bulky.id Opens New Warehouse
news.excerpt: Bulky.id officially opens a new warehouse to accelerate distribution across various regions.

news.excerpt: New collaborations strengthen the supply chain and improve delivery efficiency.

news.title: SME Resellers Growing
news.excerpt: Thousands of business owners leverage liquidation stock to grow their businesses.

news.title: Sorting Technology Gets Faster
news.excerpt: Bulky continues to improve accuracy and speed of the warehouse sorting process.

section6.heading: At BULKY ID, every container and pallet is handled to the highest standard
section6.p: As Indonesia's first online retail liquidation platform, Bulky.id is here to help business owners get the best stock, turning surplus goods into new profitable and sustainable business opportunities.

v1.title: Unboxing 100kg clothing pallet – contents and estimated selling price
v1.description: In this video we open a 100kg mixed clothing pallet from Bulky Cibinong warehouse. We go through each item, product condition, and estimate the selling price you can get as a reseller on marketplace or offline store.

v2.title: How to register & place your first order on the Bulky app
v2.description: Complete guide to registering an account and placing your first order on the Bulky app. From registration, verification, to checkout.

v3.title: Quick tour of Bulky Cibinong warehouse – pickup & sorting area
v3.description: See firsthand how the sorting and pickup process works at Bulky Cibinong warehouse. A clean, well-organized area ready to serve you.

v4.title: From 1 pallet to regular distributor – a Bulky buyer's story
v4.description: Pak Rudi shares how he started with just 1 small pallet and is now a regular distributor who shops every month at Bulky.

v5.title: Tips to calculate ROI before buying a pallet – don't buy blindly!
v5.description: Before buying a pallet, make sure you've calculated the ROI. In this video we discuss a simple formula to estimate profit from each pallet.

v6.title: Warehouse pickup process – what do you need to prepare?
v6.description: Planning to pick up your pallet yourself? Here's a list of things to prepare before you come: documents, vehicle, and on-site procedures.

v7.title: Unboxing refurbished electronics pallet – is it worth it?
v7.description: This time we try unboxing a refurbished electronics pallet. There are phones, earphones, chargers, and other gadgets. Let's see the condition and estimated value!

v8.title: FAQ: What if there are damaged products in the pallet?
v8.description: Many people ask about discrepancy and damaged products. In this video we answer the most frequently asked questions from Bulky buyers about product conditions in pallets.
